blueprint.name: IBM ROKS + BNK (roksbnkctl)
blueprint.description: Provision an IBM Cloud ROKS cluster and install BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes (BNK) with roksbnkctl. Credential-backed by an IBM Cloud credential template; region and resource group inherit from the selected template.

required.name: prefix
required.label: Resource prefix
required.description: Prefix for all resource names (e.g. acme-eu).

required.name: cluster_name
required.label: Cluster name (or existing name/ID)
required.description: Name for a new ROKS cluster, or the name/ID of an existing cluster to attach to.

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region for the cluster. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: resource_group
required.label: Resource group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

optional.name: cluster_create
optional.label: Create a new cluster
optional.description: On = provision a new ROKS cluster. Off = attach to the existing cluster named above.

optional.name: openshift_version
optional.label: OpenShift version
optional.description: OpenShift version for a new cluster (e.g. 4.18). Blank = roksbnkctl default.

optional.name: workers_per_zone
optional.label: Workers per zone
optional.description: Worker nodes per zone for a new cluster (e.g. 2). Blank = roksbnkctl default.

optional.name: cluster_vpc
optional.label: Existing cluster VPC (ID)
optional.description: Adopt an existing cluster VPC by ID — the new cluster lands in it. Blank = create one.

optional.name: install_bnk
optional.label: Install BNK
optional.description: Install BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes.

optional.name: install_testing
optional.label: Deploy testing phase
optional.description: Deploy the roksbnkctl testing phase.

optional.name: install_gateway
optional.label: Deploy gateway phase
optional.description: Deploy the roksbnkctl gateway phase.

optional.name: existing_transit_gateway
optional.label: Existing Transit Gateway (name/ID)
optional.description: Adopt an existing Transit Gateway by name/ID — the new cluster + testing VPC attach to it. Blank = create one.

optional.name: testing_vpc_name
optional.label: Testing VPC name
optional.description: Name for the testing client VPC to create (testing phase). Blank = prefix-derived.

optional.name: bigip_url
optional.label: CIS BIG-IP URL
optional.description: BIG-IP management URL for the BNK CIS controller (optional).

optional.name: bigip_username
optional.label: CIS BIG-IP username
optional.description: BIG-IP username for CIS (optional).

optional.name: bigip_password
optional.label: CIS BIG-IP password
optional.description: BIG-IP password for CIS (optional).
